statement: SK Hynix's HBM4 yield has separately touched 80%, putting the two Korean HBM suppliers at similar production efficiency.
why: Two suppliers at comparable yield means buyers gain a credible second source for HBM4, which reduces single-supplier bottleneck risk on accelerator supply.

impact.mechanism: Parity in yield between the two largest HBM makers expands aggregate qualified HBM4 output and weakens any one supplier's ability to constrain accelerator builds.

evidence.excerpt: SK Hynix's own HBM4 yield has separately touched the 80% mark, putting the two Korean suppliers at similar production efficiency as the AI memory race intensifies

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; no primary supplier disclosure of yield.
